text:
- Use named arm; if none, arm="auto". Do not move/grasp/switch. Keep the arm returned by articulate holding the lid edge (do not release or home it).
- Locate laptop, then one articulate motion="open", degrees 80-90. EXECUTED/handle_found alone is not enough; accept low swing_deg only if images show the lid open.
- After articulate, keep holding the lid and visually verify it is open. Expert demos end with the opening gripper still on the lid edge; a failure had EXECUTED and passing on_table/released checks but the hand had let go.
- Do not rely on done checks or height; on_table can pass while the lid is closed. If images show the lid closed, retry one open unless the instruction says one motion.
- Do not chase 13-15 cm or add articulations; extra attempts can close/move the laptop.
goal: Laptop lid visibly open, laptop on table, the opening gripper still holding the lid edge; no height requirement.
